run_generate_questions: run the generate_questions script to create question/answer pairs from CNN or Daily Mail news stories
download_urls_wayback: download archived news story URLs from the Wayback Machine for a specified corpus
parse_html_stories: parse HTML news stories from CNN or Daily Mail into structured content and highlights
anonymize_entities: anonymize named entities in tokenized news stories with @entity placeholders
generate_question_contexts: generate question/answer pairs from anonymized news stories by matching entities in highlights to content
